text: The dentist is kind and the fillings and extractions are good. However, it seems the staff doesn't manage their schedules properly and doesn't know how much time to allow for each patient. They often make patients wait 30-60 minutes, the longest I've ever waited was 2.5 hours. I had to go home to eat before continuing. If they know there's a major case, they should allow more time, instead of accepting all appointments without notice. Or, if they know a case will be delayed, they should call to reschedule instead of making patients wait like that. It's a waste of time.

text: I am a mother who cares about my children's dental health since their first tooth came in. I have been seeing a dentist near my house every 6 months and have never had any problems or cavities, except for my youngest who had a lot of tartar. I happened to take my children to see Dr. A and found that each of my children had cavities in 4 spots! I really wondered if all of that happened within 6 months. I still brush my children's teeth regularly. After that, I have been taking my children to see Dr. A regularly. The doctor is patient (he can handle my children) but doesn't let things go by. He examines thoroughly and doesn't rush because he sees that children have less patience than adults. Most importantly, he scraped off all the tartar for my youngest very well. I am very impressed.
